'''Filice Ginzork''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Arhan]]. She married [[Peert Ginzork]] sometime around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and was part of the private security organization "[[The Shield]]." She was a skilled [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and was secretly a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Filice Ginzork married [[Peert Ginzork]]. She worked as a private security specialist for [[The Shield]], a group that protected corporate couriers and executives and had recently branched into counter-espionage. She was also secretly a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a fact that was hidden from both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the corporations that hired her and her company.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Ginzork was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Arhan]] who had a very thin and frail body and very long facial features.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Ginzork was a talented [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who was highly skilled at [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming and repair. She was also trained in a variety of skills useful to an operative such as investigation, persuasion, stealth, urban survival, and basic forms of combat.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Ginzork carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[recording rod]] a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and a [[portable computer]]. She also carried [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], a [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]], four [[Computer spike/Legends|computer spikes]], a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]], a [[lectroticker]], a lockpick, and a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[cheater]] chip.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Filice Ginzork was designed by [[Rick Olshak]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. She was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
